title: Support and diagnostic leakage adversarial supplement
safety_limits: synthetic canary values only; no real secret, credential, patient, customer, or transaction data
no GitHub mutation, product execution, runtime connection, SQL execution, deployment, or production operation
a prepared denial oracle is not a product finding or passing runtime evidence

eligibility.required_runtime: isolated support/log pipeline with synthetic canaries

cases.attack_or_failure: look up a synthetic reference owned by another tenant and compare not-found versus forbidden behavior
cases.expected_result: uniform denial reveals neither record existence nor foreign scope metadata
cases.evidence_to_pass: same response class, bounded timing/size distribution, and zero foreign identifiers in the isolated trace

cases.attack_or_failure: inject CANARY_SECRET_A, a synthetic connection fragment, and a synthetic customer-row marker into validation failures
cases.expected_result: structured logs retain safe correlation and error class while removing every canary payload
cases.evidence_to_pass: sink-by-sink capture proves canary absence and preserves correlation/build/object metadata

cases.attack_or_failure: cause a synthetic command failure whose request body contains a password-shaped canary and SQL-shaped text
cases.expected_result: console, test report, attachment, and annotation redact the body without hiding the failing contract identity
cases.evidence_to_pass: four-channel artifact scan has zero canary matches and a usable sanitized failure reference

cases.attack_or_failure: request a bundle after synthetic config, license-path, cookie, authorization-header, and customer-row canaries were observed
cases.expected_result: bundle is allowlisted, scope-authorized, and contains none of the canaries or raw configuration
cases.evidence_to_pass: manifested bundle contents plus recursive canary scan and access-denial test

cases.attack_or_failure: trigger parser, authorization, and downstream timeout failures with canaries in path, query, header, and body
cases.expected_result: client receives a stable safe error and correlation ID, never stack, SQL, filesystem path, secret, or foreign identifier
cases.evidence_to_pass: response corpus scan plus correlation lookup using only authorized sanitized metadata

cases.attack_or_failure: send one synthetic denied operation through audit, metrics, tracing, alerting, and dead-letter paths
cases.expected_result: each sink uses the minimum authorized dimensions; no sink restores a value redacted by the producer
cases.evidence_to_pass: five-sink lineage inventory, access matrix, retention identity, and zero-canary scan
